features.plain: Admins see an export button on the invoice list
features.done_when: An admin sees the export button and a staff user does not.
features.description: Export button on /invoices, visible only to role=admin
features.verify: Login as admin, open /invoices, button present. Login as staff, button absent.

features.plain: Exporting downloads the invoices currently shown as a spreadsheet file
features.done_when: The downloaded file holds exactly the filtered invoices, in the same column order as the table.
features.description: Export downloads invoices.csv honouring the active filters
features.verify: Filter status=paid, click export, open the file, only paid rows present, column order matches the table.

features.plain: Searching invoices finds the right customer near the top
features.done_when: The search evaluation reports its scores on the sample queries.
features.description: Evaluate invoice search on fixtures/search-queries.json and report precision@5 and recall@10
features.verify: Run npm run eval:search, both metrics land in evidence, precision@5 is compared with its target.

features.plain: The export button looks like the rest of the toolbar
features.done_when: Screenshots of the toolbar in light and dark mode are approved.
features.description: Style the export button like the existing toolbar buttons in light and dark mode
features.verify: Open /invoices as admin in light and dark mode, screenshot the toolbar, the button matches its neighbours.

features.plain: Exporting an empty list gives a file with only the column names
features.done_when: A filter with no results exports a file with one line.
features.description: Empty result set exports the header row only
features.verify: Filter to zero results, export, file has exactly one line.

features.plain: Customer names with commas, quotes or line breaks come out intact
features.done_when: Any customer name survives the export and reads back unchanged.
features.description: Commas, quotes and newlines in customer names are escaped per RFC 4180
features.verify: Property test with fast-check over arbitrary strings round-trips through a CSV parser.

features.plain: Exporting ten thousand invoices finishes quickly
features.done_when: Ten thousand invoices export in under ten seconds.
features.verify: Seed 10k rows, export completes under 10 seconds, memory stays flat.

features.plain: Filtering and paging through invoices work as before
features.done_when: The existing invoice tests pass with the same count.
features.description: Existing invoice filters and pagination unchanged
features.verify: invoices.spec.ts green, baseline test count unchanged.

features.done_when: A staff user gets a refusal and no file.
features.verify: Request as staff user, expect 403 and no file.
